name: MiniMax H3 Image
description: Text-to-image and reference-image editing with the six-step PDD checkpoint. Requires the MiniMax-H3-Image 2D VAE and either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder with its vision tower or the smaller P-H3-Image text encoder (Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector).

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (required when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)
